title: 第9章 第一次兑换技能-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    顾承安接过来，字写得很好看，看得出来是练过的，从头到尾看了一遍。

    每一个细节都被记录了下来，几乎原样还原。

    确认没问题，他在最后签上名字。

    苏楠收回笔录本，从口袋里掏出一张名片。

    “后续可能需要你配合补充材料。有什么事，打这个电话。”

    名片很简洁。鹏城市公安局刑事侦查支队，重案一组，苏楠。下面一行手机号。

    顾承安接过来揣进兜里。

    “那个赵辉，”他顿了顿，有些不好意思“公安部通缉令上说的悬赏，那个……”

    苏楠看了他一眼。

    “最高二十万。抓获归案后，经核实确认举报人信息，会按程序发放，后续会通知你的。”

    “噢。”

    顾承安点了下头。

    行，承认就好。

    苏楠转身走了两步，又停下来，侧头看他。

    “顾承安。”

    “嗯？”

    “下次遇到这种情况，先报警，即使是错误也没关系，只要不是故意就行。不要一个人跟踪可疑人员。你今天运气好，但运气这东西，用一次少一次。”

    说完，她走向车间方向。

    顾承安站在原地，看着她的背影消失在警戒线后面。

    运气这东西，用一次少一次。

    他觉得这话挺有道理，暗暗提醒自己，今天自己孟浪了，只是身体素质好就去逞能，即使开了挂后面也得小心。

    笔录做完，现场勘查结束，都到凌晨了。

    一个年纪稍大的刑警过来拍了拍他的肩膀。

    “小伙子，今天真是干了件大事。A级通缉犯，全国就剩没几个在逃的了，你给逮着一个。还顺带一个走私犯。回头区里可能还要给你发个见义勇为的表彰。”

    顾承安笑了笑，开玩笑道：“那锦旗能换钱不？”

    那刑警愣了一下，然后笑了：“你小子。”

    顾承安骑上电动车，离开工业园。

    夜风灌进领口，凉飕飕的。

    回到出租屋。

    锁好门，拉上窗帘。

    顾承安坐到床边，第一时间拿出手机。

    点开警务通app，进入国安页面。

    向联络员春风发了一封邮件，告诉了今天抓到了A级通缉犯和一个走私团伙头目的事情。还有可能有最高20万奖金的事。询问自己到时候是否需要上交。

    很快收到春风的回复，“收到，等通知。”

    没了！

    真是够惜字如金的，反正已经如实汇报过了，不管了。

    他有些期待的唤出系统面板。

    【正义值： 855】
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​.

Every detail has been recorded and restored almost to its original state.

After confirming that there was no problem, he signed his name at the end.

Su Nan took back the transcript and took out a business card from his pocket.

“You may be required to provide supplementary materials in the follow-up. If you need anything, please call me.”

The business card is very simple.Pengcheng City Public Security Bureau Criminal Investigation Detachment, Serious Case Group, Su Nan.Mobile phone number on the bottom line.

Gu Chengan took it and put it in his pocket.

"That Zhao Hui," he paused, a little embarrassed, "The reward mentioned in the wanted notice of the Ministry of Public Security, that..."

Su Nan glanced at him.

"The maximum amount is 200,000. After being arrested and brought to justice, the informant's information will be verified and confirmed, and it will be issued according to the procedures, and you will be notified later."

"Oh."

Gu Chengan nodded.

​ ​ Okay, just admit it.

Su Nan turned around and took two steps, then stopped and looked sideways at him.

"Gu Chengan."

"Huh?"

"Next time you encounter this situation, call the police first. Even if it is a mistake, it doesn't matter, as long as it is not intentional. Don't follow suspicious people alone. You are lucky today, but luck is something that needs to be used less and less."

After saying that, she walked towards the workshop.

Gu Chengan stood there, watching her disappear behind the cordon.

Luck is something that should be used once and less once.

He felt that this was quite reasonable, and secretly reminded himself that he was in trouble today, and he only had to show off if he was in good physical condition, and he had to be careful even if he was cheating.

It was already early in the morning after the transcripts were completed and the on-site investigation was completed.

An older detective came over and patted him on the shoulder.

"Young man, you really did something big today. There are only a few A-level wanted criminals on the run in the country, and you caught one. There was also a smuggler with you. The district may even give you a commendation for your bravery."

Gu Chengan smiled and joked: "Can the banner be exchanged for money?"

The detective was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "You kid."

Gu Chengan rode an electric bike and left the industrial park.

The night breeze blew into the collar, making it chilly.

Return to the rental house.

Lock the door and close the curtains.

Gu Chengan sat beside the bed and took out his cell phone immediately.

Click on the Police Pass app and enter the national security page.

I sent an email to the liaison officer Chunfeng, telling me about the capture of a Class A wanted criminal and the leader of a smuggling gang today.There may also be a bonus of up to 200,000.Ask yourself if you need to turn it in then.

Soon I received a reply from Chunfeng, "Received, waiting for notification."

Gone!

I really cherish my words like gold. Anyway, I have reported it truthfully, so I don’t care.

He called up the system panel with some anticipation.

【Justice value: 855】
